Apps

List an app’s builds

Read builds for one app. Filter by processing state and follow a cursor to retrieve additional builds.

GET/apps/{appId}/builds

Proposed Read parity · Service not implemented

Request

Routes are relative to your connection. Use a facade API key; the service manages Apple authentication.

cURL
BASE='https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example'

curl --fail-with-body "$BASE/apps/1234567890/builds?processingState=PROCESSING" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ASC_FACADE_KEY"
JavaScript
const base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example";
const response = await fetch(`${base}/apps/1234567890/builds?processingState=PROCESSING`, {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.ASC_FACADE_KEY}` }
});

const body = await response.json();
if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(body.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${response.status}`);
}
console.log(body);
Python
import json
import os
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

base = "https://asc.example.com/v1/connections/conn_example"
request = Request(
    f"{base}/apps/1234567890/builds?processingState=PROCESSING",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['ASC_FACADE_KEY']}"},
)
try:
    with urlopen(request) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except HTTPError as error:
    detail = json.load(error)
    raise RuntimeError(detail["error"]["message"]) from error

asc.example.com is a placeholder for your deployment. Examples use fictional IDs.

Path parameters

NameTypeDescription
appIdRequiredstringApple’s app ID. Returned by List apps.

Query parameters

NameTypeDescription
processingStatestringOne or more comma-separated states: PROCESSING, FAILED, INVALID, VALID.
versionstringFilter by the uploaded build’s version string.
expiredstringFilter by true or false.
limitDefault 50integerNumber of builds per page. Maximum 200.
cursorstringOpaque cursor from the preceding response.
sortstringUse -uploadedDate for newest uploads first. Also supports version and preReleaseVersion, with a leading minus for descending order.

Response

A page of flat objects, with an opaque continuation cursor.

200 · application/json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "build_123",
      "appId": "1234567890",
      "version": "42",
      "uploadedDate": "2026-10-13T18:00:00Z",
      "expirationDate": "2027-01-11T18:00:00Z",
      "expired": false,
      "minOsVersion": "18.0",
      "processingState": "PROCESSING"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}

Illustrative response. Optional read fields may be absent or null; unknown enum values are preserved.

Response fields

NameTypeDescription
itemsobject[]The current page of plain resource objects. An empty collection returns an empty array.
nextCursorstring | nullOpaque continuation token, or null when the collection is complete. Pass it back as cursor.

Each item

NameTypeDescription
idstringApple’s resource ID. Keep this string unchanged when addressing a resource.
appIdstringThe app that owns this resource.
versionstringThe uploaded build’s version string; this is separate from the store versionString.
uploadedDatestring · date-timeWhen Apple received the build, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
expirationDatestring · date-timeWhen this build expires for testing, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
expiredbooleanWhether the build has expired.
minOsVersionstringThe minimum supported OS version reported by the build.
lsMinimumSystemVersionstringApple’s ls minimum system version value, preserved in the read response.
computedMinMacOsVersionstringApple’s computed min mac os version value, preserved in the read response.
computedMinVisionOsVersionstringApple’s computed min vision os version value, preserved in the read response.
iconAssetTokenobjectApple’s icon asset token, preserved as returned.
processingStatestringApple’s build-processing state. This does not indicate App Review approval.
ValuesPROCESSING, FAILED, INVALID, VALID
buildAudienceTypestringWhether a build is internal-only or eligible for App Store distribution.
ValuesINTERNAL_ONLY, APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE
usesNonExemptEncryptionbooleanWhether the build uses encryption that is not exempt from export compliance.

Behavior

  • processingState describes build processing. It does not indicate App Review approval or whether a version is live.
  • The adapter uses Apple’s app-build endpoint for an unfiltered list. Filtering uses GET /v1/builds with filter[app] fixed to appId, so filters apply across the collection rather than to one page.

Pagination

Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters and ordering. Stop when it is null. Each request returns one bounded page; the service never reports a capped or incomplete traversal as a complete collection.

Errors

HTTPTypeDescription
400invalid_queryUnsupported filter, sort, limit, or cursor.
401unauthorizedMissing or invalid facade API key.
403forbidden / upstream_forbiddenThe caller or configured Apple key cannot read this resource.
404resource_not_foundThe requested resource or exact locale is absent or outside the caller’s scope.
429rate_limitedA facade or Apple rate limit was reached. Respect Retry-After when returned.
502–504upstream errorApple authentication, response parsing, availability, or timeout failure; this is not an empty result.

Apple mapping

Upstream route and translation

The adapter calls GET /v1/apps/{id}/builds. Read Apple’s original endpoint ↗

Filtered requests use GET /v1/builds with filter[app] supplied from the path. Apple’s filter reference ↗

Apple’s data, attributes, and relationships envelopes are translated inside the service. Read access does not make these fields writable.
